subject: pri-info
title: (R)PRI.INFO.-----SG.------PROJ.DY.
description: Triple-crossing diagram in R(AS)CM(I)-23, the section on radio as the medium through which rock music attracted new listeners and through which 'this activity (rock music) has also contributed to the present curiosity about creative improvised music.' The prose immediately above identifies the structural mechanism the diagram makes explicit: 'once a person has a chance to be exposed to a given particular, within a given time frame, he or she is apt to find some aspect of its focus that can be positively experienced.' The triple-crossing diagrams that exposure-mechanism: (R)PRI-INFO (the reality of principle information — the form's working content as it travels through the medium) crossed with SG (source initiation) crossed with PROJ-DY (projectional dynamics). PRI-INFO sits at upper-left with the subject-arrow; TH-CONT (thrust continuance) hangs below from the stretch between PRI-INFO and SG. SG sits centrally as the bridging hub; AFI (affinity insight) at the very bottom — written in parentheses '(afi)' — hangs by a *dashed* line from the same stretch, amplifying some aspect of SG. PROJ-DY is partner-axis at upper-center-right; (P)CULT-INFO hangs from the stretch between SG and PROJ-DY. TR (transformation) branches from the CULT-INFO line, and SOC-RT (social reality) and C-CONT (composite continuance) branch from TR.
